audience: founder of a 5-person B2B outbound agency selling research and enablement to edtech and consumer-app companies

claims.text: Duolingo, Inc. is an American educational technology company that produces learning apps and provides language certification.
Duolingo was founded in 2011 by Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker, and its Class A shares trade on Nasdaq under the ticker DUOL.
Duolingo's catalogue spans 42 languages plus courses in music, math and chess.
Duolingo runs a freemium model: the core learning experience is free with ads, while subscriptions remove ads and add unlimited energy and generative-AI features.

Subscription is the largest revenue line: $873.44 million of the $1,038 million reported for fiscal year 2025, against $79.73 million from advertising and $42.01 million from the Duolingo English Test.
Duolingo also earns from in-app purchases of virtual currency and power-ups and from the paid Duolingo English Test certification.
The Duolingo Android app on Google Play lists in-app purchases from R$4.90 to R$719.99 per item and carries ads in the free tier.
claims.source_title: Duolingo: Language Lessons on Google Play

claims.text: Duolingo Max is positioned as a subscription tier above Super Duolingo and adds AI features such as Video Call and Roleplay.
claims.source_title: Introducing Duolingo Max, a learning experience powered by GPT-4

claims.text: Duolingo reported 10.9 million paying subscribers as of June 2025.
Duolingo Max's Video Call and Roleplay features are powered by OpenAI's GPT-4, which Duolingo says it refined with OpenAI over several months.
claims.source_title: Introducing Duolingo Max, a learning experience powered by GPT-4

claims.text: Duolingo maintains a public GitHub organization with 12 public repositories; the organization was created in July 2011.
In 2025 Duolingo announced an AI-first strategy that would replace contractors where AI can do the work, which triggered a public user backlash.
Duolingo publishes engineering, learning-science and product research at research.duolingo.com.
Duolingo's market capitalisation was about $6.71 billion on 27 September 2026.
Duolingo's fiscal 2025 revenue was $1,038 million, up 38.71% year over year from $748.02 million in fiscal 2024.
The 24 analysts tracked by StockAnalysis had a consensus rating of Hold with an average price target of $134.29 on 27 September 2026.
Duolingo's shares fell 52.35% over the 52 weeks ending 25 September 2026.
Luis von Ahn is the co-founder and chief executive officer of Duolingo.
Severin Hacker is the co-founder and chief technology officer of Duolingo.
Duolingo publishes open roles and location information at careers.duolingo.com.
Duolingo operates a press page at press.duolingo.com for company announcements.
Duolingo for Business sells team language learning, giving a B2B entry point for partnership or reseller conversations.
Duolingo for Schools is a dedicated classroom offering that could anchor an education-partnership pitch.
The Duolingo English Test is a low-cost English certification product and a distinct revenue line.
Duolingo's YouTube channel is one of its long-running public marketing surfaces.

Duolingo for Schools gives an education-partnership wedge for agencies that serve schools or training providers.

icp_fit.reason: Duolingo is a large listed company rather than the SMB ICP this product targets; it is used as the demo fixture because every claim can be verified from reachable public sources, and its B2B lines still make it a legitimate outbound target.
